metadata.description: Matej's Claude Code skills: one place to install them in any project or session.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Frontend design taste skills (design-taste-frontend, minimalist, brutalist, high-end visual design, redesign, image-to-code, brandkit, and more) by Leonxlnx.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend work: /impeccable audit, critique, polish and more, with agents and an anti-pattern detector hook. By Paul Bakaus.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Browser automation with Microsoft's playwright-cli: drive a real browser, take snapshots and screenshots, trace, mock requests and generate Playwright tests. Needs `npm install -g @playwright/cli`.

plugins.name: design-md
plugins.description: 74 ready-made DESIGN.md design systems modeled on real products (Stripe, Linear, Vercel, Apple, Notion, ...). Say "make it look like Linear" and Claude installs the matching DESIGN.md and builds from it. From VoltAgent/awesome-design-md.

plugins.name: img2threejs
plugins.description: Turn a reference image of an object or character into a quality-gated, animation-ready procedural Three.js model built in code. Needs Python 3.10+. From hoainho/img2threejs.
